chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q4 — Inference (4 points)
chunks.content: AP Statistics FRQ 4 focuses on Inference, 4 points. Each lettered part is scored E/P/I and combined into an integer 0–4. Typical tasks: state hypotheses, identify and check conditions for the appropriate procedure (t-test, z-test, chi-square, or confidence interval), compute the test statistic/interval, and state a conclusion in context linked to the p-value/interval. Common failure: hypotheses about statistics rather than parameters; conditions listed but not verified with the data; a conclusion not linked to the p-value or not in context; wrong procedure.

chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q4 exemplar — Sample 4A, 4/4
chunks.content: Q4 scored 4/4 — all parts essentially correct: parameter hypotheses, verified conditions, correct test statistic/interval, and a contextual conclusion linked to the p-value/interval. Full-credit model for the inference question.

chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q4 exemplar — Sample 4B, 3/4
chunks.content: Q4 scored 3/4 — most parts correct with one partial, commonly conditions stated but not verified with the data, or a conclusion missing full context/linkage to the p-value. Illustrates a strong inference response one part short.

chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q4 exemplar — Sample 4C, 1/4
chunks.content: Q4 scored 1/4 — mostly incorrect/partial: hypotheses about statistics, unverified conditions, or a conclusion not linked to the p-value/context. Illustrates weak command of the inference procedure.
